title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your school's information, preferences, and account security.
loadError: Unable to load the school's information.

administrateurs.title: Administrators
administrateurs.description: Accounts with access to the school's management workspace.

inviteCard.title: Invite a new administrator
inviteCard.description: Send an email invitation to a team member so they can join the management workspace.

actions.promoteBody: {name} will get full access to the management workspace. Their current roles will be removed.
actions.demoteBody: {name} will lose full access. Assign them one or more roles afterwards.
actions.removeBody: {name} will no longer have access to the school's management workspace. This takes effect immediately.
actions.cannotRemoveTeacher: This account is linked to a teacher: manage their access from the teacher record.

modal.title: Invite a member
modal.subtitle: An email with an activation link (valid for 7 days) will be sent.
modal.roleMemberHint: Access limited to the roles assigned below.
modal.staffRolesHint: Without a role, the member will not see any screen until one is assigned.

errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_IN_USE: This email address is already used by another account.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This account is already part of the school.

anneeScolaire.title: School Year & Calendar
anneeScolaire.subtitle: Define terms and assessment periods.
anneeScolaire.noTermsConfigured: No period configured yet: add the first one with "New period".
anneeScolaire.noYearConfigured: No school year configured: create the first period with "New period".

termTypeAndToggle.gradeEntryDesc: Allow teachers to enter grades for this period.

newTermModal.title: New school period
newTermModal.intro: Add a term or semester to the {academicYearLabel} year
newTermModal.statusHint: Calculated automatically from the dates above.
newTermModal.info: Once created, the period will appear in the school calendar and be available for grade entry, attendance management, and report card generation.

apparence.title: Colour theme
apparence.description: Choose the app's colour palette. Personal preference: it applies immediately, on all your devices, and doesn't change anything for other members.

etablissement.title: School information
etablissement.subtitle: This information appears on report cards and official documents.

langue.title: Interface language
langue.description: Choose the app's language. Personal preference: it applies immediately, on all your devices, and doesn't change anything for other members.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose which events you want to be notified about, by email or in the app.

BULLETIN_GENERATED.label: Report cards generated
BULLETIN_GENERATED.desc: When a report card is ready to view.

UNEXCUSED_ABSENCE.label: Unexcused absences
UNEXCUSED_ABSENCE.desc: When a student is marked absent without justification.

TEACHER_ACTIVITY_DIGEST.label: Teacher activity
TEACHER_ACTIVITY_DIGEST.desc: Summary of entries (grades, attendance) by the teaching staff.

WEEKLY_SUMMARY.label: Weekly summary
WEEKLY_SUMMARY.desc: A recap of the school's activity every week.

password.subtitleSet: You signed in with Google. Set a password so you can also sign in by email.
password.hint: Min. 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one digit
password.errorMismatch: The confirmation doesn't match the new password.
password.setToast: Password set. You can now sign in by email.

errors.passwordPwned: This password has leaked: choose another one.
errors.passwordAlreadySet: A password is already set. Use "change password" instead.

password.logoutWarning: After changing it, you'll be logged out of all active sessions.

zoneDangereuse.title: Danger zone
zoneDangereuse.subtitle: These actions are irreversible. Proceed with caution.

export.title: Export all data
export.desc: Download a full ZIP file with all students, grades, report cards, and settings.

resetYear.title: Reset the school year
resetYear.desc: Erase all grades and attendance for the current year. Students and teachers are kept.
resetYear.warning: All grades, assessments, attendance, objectives, and remarks for the active school year will be permanently deleted. Students, teachers, classes, and subjects are kept. This action is irreversible.

deleteSchool.title: Delete the school account
deleteSchool.desc: This action will permanently delete all data: students, teachers, report cards, and settings. No recovery is possible.
deleteSchool.warning: The school and all its data (students, teachers, classes, grades, report cards...) will be permanently deleted. Your user account will stay active but will lose access to this school. This action is irreversible.
